pillar_1_to_2.description: Contract for passing detected spill from the Detector (Pillar 1) to OpenDrift (Pillar 2)

data.notes: List of (lat, lon, time) points representing the oil spill pixels in real world coordinates.

pillar_2_to_3.description: Contract for passing the estimated backtracked origin from OpenDrift (Pillar 2) to GFW API (Pillar 3)

data.notes: The bounding box (minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat) and the 24-48h time window enclosing the simulated origin of the spill to query vessel presence.
